title: Adjunctions coordinates for smooth purity
statement: Use [def-pur-transport-concrete-coefficients], [sk-prop-sf-existence], [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Write $P_c(X)$ for the intersection of bounded finite-constant-model constructibility and finite Tor amplitude, and $\mathcal L_c(X)$ for its recorded localizing closure. The inclusion $P_c(X)\to\mathcal L_c(X)$ is the full-subcategory inclusion. Given proofs of preservation, support is the full-subcategory restriction of the actual compactification functor $R\bar f_*j_!$, source is the restriction of $J_{f,c,d}$, and the exceptional functor is the restriction of the specified Brown right adjoint on $\mathcal L$. For two adjunctions with the same left functor, an isomorphism of right functors is counit-compatible precisely when applying the left functor to it and then the second counit gives the first counit at every object.
